Password Policy Update — Effective 14 April

All staff must rotate their network passwords by Friday 18 April at 17:00. Passwords must be at least 14 characters and cannot repeat any of your last five. If you use the shared payroll portal, reset it through the SSO page at https://sso.northbridge-hr.example.com rather than emailing the helpdesk. Staff who miss the deadline will be locked out until the next business day, so please plan ahead. Contact it-helpdesk@northbridge-hr.example.com with any questions.

intent.requested_action: rotate network passwords before the deadline

items.text:
HR & Finance Helpdesk Runbook — Quarter Close

During quarter close, the helpdesk handles a higher volume of payroll and expense tickets. Agents should triage tickets tagged 'Q-close' first and route payroll corrections to the finance queue. Standard SLAs still apply: first response within four hours, resolution within two business days. If a ticket involves a payment above £10,000, escalate to the finance manager on duty rather than handling it directly.

Agents must not share employee salary details in chat channels. Use the secure ticket note field instead. The helpdesk mailbox is monitored 08:00–18:00, and anything arriving after hours is queued for the next morning. Reminders about the close timeline go out every Monday until the period is signed off.

intent.requested_action: triage and escalate tickets per SLA
